meta.title: Delta Privé — Coming Soon
meta.description: A boat under construction for private journeys through the Tigre Delta. Join the waiting list.

about.paragraph1: We are building a boat designed for one thing only: to sail the Tigre Delta the way few ever have. Fine woods, generous spaces and a crew devoted to a single group per departure.
about.paragraph2: When she is launched, the first journeys will belong to those already on our list.

boat.title: A brand-new boat
boat.text: Designed and built to order at the shipyard, finished down to the last detail.

groups.title: Small groups
groups.text: Private departures for a handful of guests. No shared schedules, no crowded routes.

routes.title: Curated routes
routes.text: Itineraries along the most beautiful rivers and streams of the Delta, tailored to each voyage.

waitlist.intro: Leave us your details and we will let you know before anyone else when bookings open. No spam, just an invitation.
waitlist.privacy: Your details are used only to contact you about the launch.

success.message: Thank you for your interest, we will be in touch soon.
